title: PCR Preparation Protocol for 96-Well Plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Configure plates and pipette
steps.instruction: Prepare to run the custom PCR preparation across six 96‑well plates, using either a P20 or P300 GEN2 multi‑ or single‑channel pipette as appropriate.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware definition files (JSON files with a .json extension).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file (Python script with a .py extension).

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the selected pipette; refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.
